# appmixer Provider

The `appmixer` provider manages an [Appmixer](https://appmixer.com) tenant: users, service accounts, flows, ACLs, modifiers, service/system configuration, and custom quotas. It authenticates with admin credentials via `POST /user/auth` and uses the resulting bearer token for all subsequent requests.

All three config attributes fall back to environment variables (`APPMIXER_BASE_URL`, `APPMIXER_USERNAME`, `APPMIXER_PASSWORD`) when omitted from HCL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "appmixer" {
  base_url = "https://api.your-tenant.appmixer.cloud"
  username = "admin@example.com"
  password = var.appmixer_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Appmixer API base URL. Falls back to APPMIXER_BASE_URL.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Appmixer admin password. Falls back to APPMIXER_PASSWORD.
- `username` (String) Appmixer admin username. Falls back to APPMIXER_USERNAME.
